- **The ship raised a real hole in the merge gate — [ADR-0005](adr/0005-reviewed-diff-equals-merged-diff.md), `proposed`.** `base_sha` `c2f88db` was local `main` HEAD but had **never been pushed** (`origin/main` was `d299ae3`), so GitHub computed the squash against the remote: PR #13 landed `d299ae3...85731f3`, a **strict superset** of the `c2f88db...HEAD` range the merge gate reviewed, absorbing this slice's own shaping commit. **Benign here and verified so** (the extra content was `[0007]` shaping records already covered by `spec_review` + `plan_check`, byte-identical against `origin/main`), **but in general unreviewed content can reach `main` with no gate noticing**, because a squash resolves its base server-side while `base_sha` is a purely local claim. Fix is two halves — a kernel guard (`house pr --base-sha` verifies remote-reachability) and an orchestrator ordering rule (**push `main` before cutting the slice branch**; commit every `house` record write **before** any `gh pr merge` or `git reset`). **The second half was violated during this very ship:** `house pr --set` ran after the final commit so `gh pr merge --delete-branch` aborted its *local* cleanup (the merge itself succeeded), and an uncommitted `work.discovered` append was **destroyed** by the `git reset --hard origin/main` that reconciled diverged local `main` — re-emitted at 01:44:34Z, and the discarded commit is still reachable from the local tag **`pre-0007-squash-main`**. Nothing was lost, only because the loss was noticed immediately and the tag had been cut first. Details: [`roadmap.md`](roadmap.md) → "Backlog — discovered in the `[0007]` ship".

## Infra / secrets
- GitHub: `argent-gnome/sdlc-skills` (Pages site builds from `main`). Installed via `install.sh` (symlink mode) → `~/.claude/skills/`. Current VERSION: 0.5.0 (skills bundle; unchanged by S1 — the CLI versions separately at `cli/package.json` 0.1.0).
- **Three skills, one generation, since the 2026-07-29 cutover** ([ADR-0004](adr/0004-house2-coexistence-and-advisory-hooks.md)): `house-shaper` · `house-orchestrator` · `house-builder` — the v2 trio, shipped in S2 Unit 2 under temporary `house2-*` names and renamed to canonical at S3b. They require a repo `house init` has run in (`.house/` present) and refuse otherwise. The v1 trio that held these names is retired and archived at `archive/skills-v1/`, outside the `skills/*/` glob `./install.sh` links, so it no longer installs.
- Runtime doctrine, **one file since the cutover:** `skills/house-orchestrator/references/doctrine.md` (cited by all three skills via `$HOME/.claude/skills/house-orchestrator/references/doctrine.md`), read on-demand only, never preloaded. The v1 doctrine retired with the v1 skills at S3b and now sits at `archive/skills-v1/house-orchestrator/references/doctrine.md`, uninstalled. The coexistence window is closed.
- **`house` CLI:** lives in `cli/`; **`./install.sh` now installs it** (npm install in `cli/` + `npm link`, falling back to a symlink in `~/.local/bin` if the global prefix is not writable) alongside the skill symlinks — S2 Unit 1. Tests: `cd cli && npm test`. Usage: `cli/README.md`.
- **Advisory hooks are live in this repo:** `house init` merged a house block into `.claude/settings.json` (`SessionStart`/`SessionEnd`/`PreToolUse`/`SubagentStop` → `house hook …`). Advisory-only by [ADR-0004](adr/0004-house2-coexistence-and-advisory-hooks.md) — they never block, never exit non-zero, and record `hook.degraded` when they swallow an error. Merged, never overwritten: hand-added hooks survive `house init`.
- **No hosted CI — by decision** ([`docs/adr/0003-no-hosted-ci-local-verification.md`](adr/0003-no-hosted-ci-local-verification.md)). There is no `.github/workflows` and none is to be added. The verification bar is local and unchanged in rigor: `cd cli && npm test` green **+** `house validate` exit 0 — run by the builder, then **independently re-run by the merge-gate reviewer** (never trust the builder's report). Stage-8 "CI green" is permanently n/a here.
- **GitHub repo settings:** auto-delete-head-branch is **ENABLED** on `argent-gnome/sdlc-skills` (the doctrine's repo-setup item is done) — merged PR branches are pruned by GitHub; the local branch + worktree are still yours to remove.

## Gotchas
- `docs/*.html` are **hand-authored — there is no generator, and adding one is a No-Go, not an omission** (`[0006]`'s plan bars a build step or generator dependency; its link-check script was run from a scratchpad and deliberately never committed). So: **mirror any `docs/*.md` prose change into the matching `.html` by hand.** Each mirror states the drift direction itself, in a top-of-file HTML comment *and* in its footer — `generated from <file>.md — edit the markdown, then re-render this mirror`. **Watch the one name asymmetry:** `docs/quickstart.md` → `docs/quickstart.html`, but `docs/process-v2.md` → **`docs/process.html`** (`[0006]` deliberately gave the v2 narrative's mirror the retired v1 page's URL so old inbound links land on current truth). The retired v1 pages themselves are at `archive/docs-v1/` — md + html, byte-identical, nothing deleted. The mirrors' three deliberate departures from their markdown (a `home ·` nav link, the footer note, `id=` on every heading) are recorded in [`[0006]`'s plan As-built](slices/0006-public-pages-refresh-retire-v1-pages-publish-cur/plan.md), so a diff against the markdown reads clean. *History, for anyone reading an older record:* these two docs shipped **markdown-only on purpose** in `[0005]` — the `docs/index.html` card was declined at its plan-check because that page was v1 surface, on the expectation the cutover slice `[0004]` would inherit mirroring and linking them; `[0004]` stayed inside its own No-Go and took only the **footer** (its folded advisory **A5**, "three skills: `house-shaper` · `house-orchestrator` · `house-builder`"), leaving the page unowned until `[0006]` took it.
- `install.sh` symlinks each `skills/<name>` → editing the repo file IS the live skill (run `/reload-skills` to pick up changes).
- Squash-merging a PR breaks `git branch --merged` detection — confirm merged-ness via PR state before pruning (now codified in the doctrine).
- The five sections at the top of this file are **generated** — hand-edits there are overwritten by the next `house render dev-state`. Write below the `<!-- house:manual -->` marker; the renderer parses positionally (title | generated | manual | tail) and refuses (exit 1, nothing written) on *any* content outside those regions, naming the first offender. Fix the file, then re-render — there is no back-compat path.
- `.house/index.json` is a rebuildable cache and is gitignored — never hand-edit it; run `house index`.
- **The generated `In-flight` section is "has a PR", not "is in flight."** `derive.js:72` selects `s.pr != null || any unit building`, so a shipped slice keeps rendering there forever — as of 2026-07-30 **all six PR-bearing slices** (`0001`, `0003`, `0004`, `0005`, `0006`, `0007`) render there while **every one of them is shipped and nothing at all is in flight**. (`0002` is absent only because it never had a PR of its own — it ff-merged into S2's branch.) Read `Active` for what is actually in flight — it is `- none`, which is the truth right now. Not fixable by hand; a validator/derive change is a candidate for a future slice.
- **`base_sha` is a claim about the *remote*, and nothing checks it.** A squash merge computes its base against `origin/<default>`, so a `base_sha` recorded from a local-only commit makes the merged diff a **superset** of the diff the merge gate reviewed — content reaches `main` that no gate saw, and no diff anyone looks at shows the divergence. **Push `main` before cutting the slice branch.** Second half of the same rule: **commit every `house` record write before any `gh pr merge` or `git reset`** — an uncommitted append to `.house/events.jsonl` does not survive `git reset --hard`, and `house pr --set` after the final commit is what aborts `gh pr merge --delete-branch`'s local cleanup. Both were learned the hard way at the `[0007]` ship ([ADR-0005](adr/0005-reviewed-diff-equals-merged-diff.md)); the guard is a backlog item, so until it lands this is discipline, not enforcement. Cheap insurance while merging: tag the pre-merge local `main` (`pre-<id>-squash-main` is the precedent) so a discarded commit stays reachable.
- **Kernel-owned files are CLI-written, not hand-edited:** `slice.yaml` fields, `gates/*.yaml`, `tasks.yaml` ticks, `units/NN-report.md`, `.house/events.jsonl`. Use the matching command (`house state/gate/task/block/unblock/artifact/unit/pr`) — each writes its own event, which is the whole one-writer-per-field invariant. The `PreToolUse` hook will *ask* before an Edit/Write to those paths; that prompt is the reminder, not a bug.
